intro: Create a space that breathes calm and order with our Adria wardrobe. An array of shelves, a secure drawer, and a sturdy hanger rod ensure flawless organisation, while its finish exudes timelessness.

features.title: Stylish and durable design
features.text: The Adria wardrobe is crafted from prelaminated particle board in a warm Imperial Oak finish, giving your room a modern look while standing up to everyday wear and tear.

features.title: Moisture-resistant edges for lasting beauty
features.text: All the wardrobe edges are sealed with a thick PVC banding to protect against moisture and enhance durability, so your wardrobe looks great for years, no matter the climate.

features.title: Designed to fit your storage needs
features.text: With hanging rods, shelves, and a secure drawer, this wardrobe offers plenty of storage options to keep your clothes, accessories, and valuables organised and within reach.

features.title: Built for security and peace of mind
features.text: The 3-way locking system ensures your belongings stay safe and organised, giving you peace of mind while blending seamlessly into your routine.

features.title: Premium hardware for smooth operation
features.text: The high-quality hinges and rollers make opening and closing doors effortless, while ensuring the wardrobe performs beautifully even with daily use.

care: Wipe your wooden almirah design for bedroom with a soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery of your stylish wardrobe. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping it next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
